claims.text: The scenario: 1.2 atm of N2 and O2 at the water level, seas and lakes over 28% of the surface, shield-filtered sunlight, g 1.62 m/s2, a 29.53-day solar day
The lunar column holds 7.25 times Earth's air per square metre (74,861 against 10,332 kg/m2)
Scale height about 52 km against a 1,737 km radius, H/R about 23 times Earth's; horizon air mass from 35 to about 7
One Earth day after sunset the Sun stands 12.2 deg down, the shadow 40.1 km up, with 0.465 of an isothermal column's mass above it
121,590 Pa at the water level; O2 21,227 Pa (17.5%); Earth's Ar/N2; 400 ppm CO2; global mean 1.16 atm, 1.03-1.22 atm
Seas at 28% of the surface; with rain-fed lakes 40% of the GCM's cells are water
TSIS-1 through the titania shield: 1,235 W/m2 at the top of the air, dimmed to 1,198 W/m2 (scale 0.970) in the design case; no ozone behind the shield
Column water vapour 170 kg/m2 in the design case and 348 kg/m2 in the longwave-and-ice test (years 15-19 of each); Earth about 25
Mass-mean height 48.6 km; a shell 50 km up has 5.8% more area; horizon air mass 7.1 for air and 13.5 for water against PlaSim's 35

Gravity at the 86 km tropopause 9% below the surface's; a constant-area column with falling gravity holds about 5% more air than p_s/g_s (5.3% on the design profile; 5.5% on the ledger's moist column), and the spherical shells 11.5% more per square metre of ground (84,876 against 76,096 kg/m2)
Pressure levels six times higher; droplets 6.04x, rain 2.94x, graupel 2.27x slower; sea roughness 6.04x longer; deep-water waves 0.41 of Earth's speed
Lunar convection is Earth's stretched about sixfold in size and duration; 6 km columns resolve deep storms as 1 km columns do on Earth
Soil thermal wave about 0.6 m deep, 5.4 times Earth's diurnal depth; Coriolis 5.2e-6 /s at 80 deg, inertial period 14 days
CM1 sets g = 9.81 in constants.F, module_ra_etc.F, getcape.F and morrison.F; Morrison's fall-speed laws and caps hold Earth's gravity
WRF-ELEC's NSSL sets gr = 9.8 twice and ties rain and ice ventilation to Earth's fall-speed coefficients
Breakdown cap 180 kV/m acts below ~4.5 km on Earth and ~36 km in lunar air (-44% at the ground); -7 C ground-strike level 5 km on Earth, 27-34 km on the Moon; 0.75 s sub-step for 500 m layers
SWAN's AGROW knee fixed at 1 Hz, called largely arbitrary in its comments; stock SWAN misses the sixfold similarity test by 5.44% in Hs
SWAN fixes air density at 1.28 kg/m3; CM1's air over the equatorial seas averages 1.40390 kg/m3
RRTMG sets CO2 by calendar year and carries Earth's CH4, N2O, halocarbons and ozone; CM1's beta plane uses Earth's rotation and a 6,370 km radius
Slingo's convective cover converts rain with the model's solar day (29.8 Earth days for the Moon): rain read 30x too heavy, cover +0.42; bias 0.125 ln(day)
ExoPlaSim's 360-day year of 17,280 steps holds 12.08 lunar model days of 1,430 steps; output slips 120 steps a year
CM1's Sun follows Earth's day, calendar and a 23.5 deg obliquity (radconst); soil layers 1-16 cm; the lunar thermal wave about 0.6 m
WRF-ELEC's conduction is off by default; in a month-long lunar run ion charge persisted for weeks, holding ~20 kV/m at the ground
The curved geometry takes in 10.3 W/m2 more sunlight, lets out 16.2 W/m2 more infrared, 5.8 W/m2 net, nearly all from the shells' widening; twilight 1.4 W/m2 on the ground
PlaSim's horizon magnification 35/sqrt(1 + 1224 mu^2); the Moon's factor 13.5 for water and 7.1 for air
PlaSim's thin shell and CM1's flat slab hold g constant; reference models use GM/r^2; g 5.4% lower at 48.6 km and 15.3% at 150 km
Lacis-Hansen water absorptivity left the air absorbing 7.7-8.2 points too little on 11 columns
Rayleigh normalised to a 5772 K blackbody gives too low a coefficient for the filtered Sun; TH2OC over-absorbs; uncalibrated design case passed 310 K, 315.5 K at year 12
PlaSim's two shortwave bands omit CO2 and O2, whose sunlight went to the water vapour lower down
Sasamori longwave cools the lowest two layers 9.7-11.9 W/m2 too much and the air aloft up to 12 W/m2 too little against correlated-k
CCM3 cloud water falls off on 700 ln(1+PW) m of geometric height; lunar cloud above ~20 km left nearly dry
Liquid optics for all cloud; saturation over liquid; high cloud at 180-204 K forms at 136-149% of ice saturation
RRTMG reference pressures begin at 1,053.63 hPa; the lowest 7.4-7.5 km over the sea are extrapolated in ln p; ice optics end at 140 um; the box stopped at day 6.45 at 157 um
Morrison bounds rain's mean diameter at 2.8 mm (LAMMINR) and begins breakup above 0.3 mm (brkup_db default); the capillary length is 2.46x longer at lunar g
Retained Earth calibrations: Wu drag, Komen, the AGROW coefficient, breaker index 0.73, SWASH breaking 0.6/0.3, the charging laws (Takahashi's inverts the lunar storms' polarity)
solang turns the Sun at the rotation rate and restarts each model day: skip 32.5 deg a day on the Moon, ~1 deg on Earth; equator -8.3% at 270-57 E, +17% near 164 E
The fixedorbit default puts Earth's orbit for 1 AD (23.695 deg) in place of the configured one: 149 against 29 W/m2 at 86 deg; summer rain to 60 deg
SWAN reads KTETA uninitialised with breaking off; repeated Earth runs differed ~2.5% in Hs; hidden with breaking on
CM1 on several threads parts at 3,000-7,400 s, first in total vertical momentum, in the plain Morrison box too; unlocated
PlaSim's lowest level reads up to ~20 K too cold in 0.8% of 3-day windows, most likely from the spectral transform over steep terrain
The runner's held infrared tail put 86% of sunlight in the near infrared and warmed the first run past 320 K

First electrified build: field a median 3.2x breakdown at discharge, 150 C removed; uninitialised scaling and a privatised variable caught by thread-count changes; ventilation missed, rain evaporating 1.3-1.5x too fast
The ledger's first channels absorbed 104.5 W/m2 above 500 nm against the fine grid's 66.2, 58% too much
Terrain forcing by a corner column at 2.9 km; constant vapour above the GCM's 130 km top, 6-15x ice-saturated at 140-150 km; the 45 N twilight pair on -O2 and -O3 builds
The first box rained in the mornings and was stopped at day 47; at 45 N the missing sideways transport is about a third of CM1's warm offset

Ten ExoPlaSim patches with identity defaults and three settings; CM1 gravity, CO2 and O2 as preprocessor constants and var1-var20; SWAN's knee identity at Earth's g; series rebuild the deployed sources byte for byte
V = aD^b scales as g^((b+1)/3): droplets 6.04x, rain 2.94x, graupel 2.27x slower at lunar gravity
Rayleigh damping x g/9.81 and l_inf x 9.81/g; WRF-ELEC sub-step 0.75 -> 6.8 s keeps graupel settling ~1% of a 2 km layer at 0.44 of Earth's speed
SWAN's knee at f g_E/g reproduces stock at Earth's g; sixfold similarity error 5.44% -> 0.303% in Hs and 3.91% -> 0.326% in mean period
The ledger: 10,697 channels within 1% of absorbed energy and the beam's loss by layer; 282 scattering channels below 1,250 nm; cone -6.5 W/m2 net; curved light and escape +0.7
Terms at 167 elevations from -40 to 90 deg for PlaSim layers and CM1 shells, infrared escape scaled with T^4; slant fits within 0.30% (water) and 0.08% (air)
With the Sun overhead the spherical solver's ground takes 1.3% less than the two-stream's: part of the daytime term is a solver difference
The reference: line-by-line on HITRAN2020, MT_CKD 4.3, CIA, Rayleigh, g = GM/r^2, pseudo-spherical beam; correlated-k OLR within 0.4 W/m2 at 288-290 K and 1.4 W/m2 for a saturated 330 K lunar column
First calibration: albedo within ~0.007 and OLR within ~2 W/m2; after the Sun repair the air was 8.1 points short and the water multiplier brought it within 0.3 points rms on 11 columns
PlaSim put ~nothing above 85 km against line-by-line's 4.2 W/m2; three gas bands within 0.13% of band energy; layers 1.71 -> 0.97 W/m2 rms
The longwave correction, fitted on ~2,100 cloud-free 3-day means over land and sea and scaled with T^4, removes each layer's mean error, leaving 1-5 W/m2 column to column

Ice optics below -38 C (Ebert-Curry, delta two-stream, Kristjansson-Mitchell radius); the WRF-ELEC graft: NSSL with charge, FFT/tridiagonal Poisson solver, cylindrical and branched lightning on a wrapping domain, screening
Leakage through a computed conductivity column, point discharge, a leader's crossing at 1 kV/m at sea-level density placing ground strikes between the stopping-field and -7 C bounds
Rings and boxes with their own Sun and Coriolis; nudging only above 8-16 km; the GCM's vertical wind through CM1's large-scale advection
Local-time heating and moistening; terrain forcing by column height; SWAN forced by GCM stress through an inverted Wu law, spherical at the lunar radius, band scaled by g/g_E; SWASH unmodified

Five ExoPlaSim identity runs at neutral settings; committed convective-day patch equals the staged code; kill-and-resume restart identical, output identical in 39 variables, 12 header bytes differ; seven restart hashes confirmed 2026-10-17

CM1 tilted-ring patches and local-time advection repeat a first model day bit for bit; single-thread runs repeat; the electrified supercell restarted on 4 and 2 threads repeats fields and 41 flashes; SWAN patched equals stock at Earth's g
The series rebuild every deployed source byte for byte; ExoPlaSim prefixes reproduce 32 of 34 hashed GCM runs; the two others compiled drafts
SWAN sixfold similarity: stock 5.44% (Hs) and 3.91% (Tm); patched 0.303% and 0.326% against a 1% criterion; largest peak-period difference one bin
SWASH: dispersion within 1.76% amplitude and 0.289% phase at three gravities; linear similarity 0.000908%; nonlinear run-up 1.20%
The CM1 gravity pair (pair_moon, pair_earth) failed to convect
Clear-sky split within 0.6 points rms on 11 unseen columns; 0 E air 31.4% against 31.1%; a 303 K, 338 kg/m2 column 0.7 points short against 9.7
RRTMG within 2.5 points at the crossing; on 990 cloud-free 45 N columns it cools 4.5, 8.5 and 10.2 W/m2 more than correlated-k at 0-1.8, 1.8-6.5 and 6.5-13.7 km
Electrified supercell against CM1's NSSL: updrafts within 6%, reflectivity 3.4 dBZ, condensate 9%, graupel 12%, hail within a factor of two
Against published electrification: first flash 28.5 min (27-40); rates and charge per flash in range; 1.1% ground strikes; charging several times stronger from cloud ice up to 2e8 per kg

Arithmetic checks: solang rebuild correlation 1.0000; Sun within 8e-7 and Coriolis within 3e-12 /s; field solver 1 part in 1e5; ledger channels within 0.9 W/m2 per layer; conductivity within 2-8% at 5-30 km
SWAN breaking off: ~2.5% repeat difference; early growth up to 33% with the time step, endpoints under 0.3%; small seas fail 5%; SWASH irregular input 5.22% and 6.28%
CM1 -O3 rebuild 0.28-0.32 C rms at 2 m within a day; one ledger channel of 282 at the 100-order cap, omitted tail ~3e-4 of its ground diffuse field

Missing checks: CM1 from the longwave-corrected GCM; the longwave fit at 307 K; the twilight pair's control; runtime identity of the Sun clock and water scaling; RRTMG's extrapolation; the thread race; CM1 microphysics similarity; an independent GCM
Cloud water by pressure +2.30 K (A -> A_earth_path_clouds); convective cover per Earth day +1.76 K (-> A_corrected_clouds)
Sun clock, tilt and split: +0.59 K; rain 2.91 -> 2.24 mm/day; land under 0.5 mm/day 9% -> 42%
Curved air -0.65 K, clouds returning 3.5 of the clear sky's 5.4 W/m2; gas bands -2.23 K, the top layer warming 7 K and its cirrus 2.0% -> 0.05%
At a sunlight scale of 0.970 (3.0% dimming) the corrected design case settles at 295.02 K with 2.31 mm/day
Thinner convective cloud +1.71 K; more low cloud -4.98 K; full-column cloud water -3.21 K; longwave by height with ice +11.50 K to ~307 K, vapour 348 against 170 kg/m2, high cloud ~40% against 20%
45 N ring: lowest 1.8 km 5.9 K above the GCM; the imposed transport (~15 W/m2 out of the air below 8 km) cuts it to 3.7 K
PlaSim's longwave over-cooling ~1.5 K of the rest; CM1 mixes 14-19 km deep by day; a 3-D box ran warmer, land at most 0.3 C, Earth-speed rain 1.0 C warmer
The small box: 34 mm per lunar day at the ground against the GCM's 180 mm; 85% of falling water evaporated against 64% at Earth's fall speeds
0 C level near 25 km, -40 C near 60 km, cloud tops 55-80 km in every run

Main electrified run: 530 flashes, 106 negative to ground, none positive; 0.022 per km2 per year; start 35.8 km; 108 C in cloud, 149 C to ground; hail 87% of non-inductive charging; main negative charge 40-42 km at -13 to -14 C
Takahashi's law inverts the polarity with as much charge; NSSL against Morrison: 1.0 C warmer at 2 m, night ground fog 29% against 56% of the box

Waves 4-5x as high and periods 5x as long as Earth's for the same wind; nearside sea 5.29 million km2, mean Hs 1.39 m, 68% >= 1 m, largest 4.9 m (19.3 s); 0.41 of Earth's speed; run-up 2.1 m (98th percentile) at the western Smythii face
